name: Nite Owl West
notes: Drink-only dive bar. Yelp category is 'Dive Bars', no Menu tab/photos in the photo gallery (only Inside/Outside/All). San Diego Reader profile confirms: patrons drink $4.50 well drinks and cheap beer 'while ordering Chinese takeout' — i.e. customers bring in outside food rather than the bar serving its own food menu. No website on file, Facebook/Yelp inaccessible to curl and WebFetch (403), but the Reader description independently establishes there is no in-house food menu to find. not_found per playbook's drink-only dive bar example.

name: La Colombe Coffee Roasters
blocked: No published in-cafe drink menu found for this specific location (4545 La Jolla Village Dr #2025, Westfield UTC). The restaurant's own site only lists retail bagged coffee / cold-brew kegs / gift boxes ($16-$47) via a Shopify collection page (cafe-offerings-1) -- this is the products.json/retail trap, not the espresso-bar menu, so it was not used. joe.coffee's listing for this exact location (address matched: 4301/4545 La Jolla Village Dr) has orderingUrl:null and points back to the same priced-nothing lacolombe.com page. Could not confirm a DoorDash/UberEats storefront specifically for this branch (curl 403s DoorDash; searches did not surface a store link for this address, and the browser pane's DoorDash/UberEats search requires a delivery address I could not set without providing personal location data). Genuinely may be a chain that just doesn't publish per-cup prices online, but I could not rule out a delivery-app storefront existing, so recording as blocked rather than not_found.
notes: Address on lacolombe.com/pages/cafes/la-jolla and joe.coffee listing both confirm 4545 La Jolla Village Dr #2025 / Westfield UTC, matching batch address.

name: PGA Tour Grill
blocked: Airport concession (San Diego Intl Airport, Terminal 2 W, Gate 36), operated by HMSHost. HMSHost's own brand page is marketing copy only, no menu/prices. San.org (the airport's official Shop & Dine directory, given as batch website) is a searchable directory of businesses with descriptions but no per-item prices for any concession, including this one. No delivery-app presence (not the kind of restaurant that takes DoorDash/UberEats orders). Aggregators zmenu.com, loungereview.com and tripadvisor.com all returned 403 to curl; pga-tour-grill.goto-restaurants.com does not resolve (dead/fabricated domain from a search snippet). Reviews mention scattered prices ($17 burger, $6.49 item) but no structured priced menu was found anywhere reachable.

notes: First-party menu, two full-page JPEGs (ShaneMenu_2023v6p1pic.jpg, ...p2pic.jpg) linked directly from the restaurant's own site (shanespizza.com); page 1 confirms the address '1523 San Elijo Rd South, Ste 109, San Marcos, CA 92078' matching the batch address. Prices all end in .99, consistent with the printed board, no markup pattern. Specialty pizzas are priced by the size grid printed above them (Personal/Medium/Large/X-Large = $14.99/$26.99/$30.99/$34.99) so each is recorded once per size; Design Your Own is recorded as its cheese base price per size, with individual toppings ($2.49-$4.99 each) skipped as modifiers, not dishes. name: The Nood Bar
notes: The restaurant's own site (ordernoodbar.com) is a heavy Wix Thunderbolt SPA whose online-ordering menu renders nothing in raw HTML (client-side only), and its ChowNow link (order.chownow.com/order/42814) points to a different id-space number that actually resolves to an unrelated Rochester, NY restaurant via the ChowNow API -- confirmed as a false lead, not used. Used DoorDash marketplace schema.org JSON-LD instead (server-rendered, no browser needed). Markup check: cent endings are exclusively .50/.95/.99 (12/55/11 of 78 non-round prices) with no scattered odd-cent distribution and no consistent divisor recovers round numbers cleanly -- reads as the restaurant's real pricing, not a delivery markup, but this is still a single tier-3 source so confidence is medium, not high. Dropped the 'Most Ordered' carousel as a pure duplicate sample; kept 4 items from the 'THE BEST SELLER' carousel (Every Day Hero, Backyard BBQ Platter, Hong Kong Style Noodles Soup, Golden Chicken Curry Rice) that do not appear elsewhere on the menu. 'Laksa Curry Noodle Soup' appears twice in the source (Noodle Soups and Oldies But Goodies) at the same price/description -- kept both as that is how DoorDash lists it. Categories captured: Best Seller (partial, unique items only), Appetizers, Salad, Pan-Fried Noodles, Noodle Soups, Oldies But Goodies, Fried Rice, Hom Mali Specialties, Curry, Wok Creations, Beverages -- this reads as the full food+drink menu.

notes: First-party ordering platform (SmartOnlineOrder, linked from the restaurant's own site chandarathaiescondido.com), read via its underlying WordPress moo-clover REST API: /wp-json/moo-clover/v1/categories then /categories/{uuid}/items across all 11 categories. 54 of 91 items carried a direct price. 37 items (mostly curries, stir-fries, noodle/rice entrees priced by protein choice, and a few appetizers/soups sized by piece count) showed price:'0' in the category listing; for each I fetched /wp-json/moo-clover/v1/items/{uuid} and took the cheapest option in every REQUIRED modifier group (min_required>=1), ignoring optional add-on/prep/spice-level groups, per the project's standard 'lowest required option' convention -- flagged in each such dish's description. All resolved cleanly (no item had an empty/unresolvable required group). Prices are uniformly .95-ending or clean whole/half dollars for sides -- no markup pattern (this is the restaurant's own storefront, not a delivery marketplace). name: De Oro Mine Co.
notes: Drink-only dive bar / live-music venue (Yelp category 'Dive Bars'). The restaurant's own site (deoromineco.com) has only a 'Beer Menu' link and a live-music calendar -- no food menu section exists on the site at all. Address confirmed: 9924 Campo Rd, Casa De Oro/Spring Valley, CA 91977, matching the batch address. Web search corroborates: reviews describe $3 domestic beer / $3 well cocktails, pool tables, karaoke -- and explicitly state 'Food is available next door at La Posta,' i.e. this bar does not serve its own food. not_found per the drink-only dive bar precedent.

name: Le Parfait Paris
notes: Multi-location chain (Parfait Paris/Le Parfait Paris) with 8 San Diego-area stores; confirmed the Del Mar branch specifically via the platform's location picker, which listed the pickup address as '12841 El Camino Real Ste 208, San Diego, California 92130-2962' -- matching the batch address exactly (the restaurant's own /locations/ page corroborates the same address and calls it the 'Del Mar' location). The restaurant's marketing site (parfaitparis.com) carries no priced menu; ordering runs through order.parfaitparis.com, a Square Online storefront that renders nothing in raw HTML and required the browser pane to select the Del Mar pickup location and read each category tab (curl/WebFetch could not reach the client-rendered catalog). Captured all 9 populated categories: Party Cakes, Coffees & Teas, Breads and Pastries, Desserts, Gelato, Macarons, Sandwiches and Quiches, Crepes, Soft Drinks. Skipped 'Deals' as a pure duplicate carousel (its 5 items are box/platter items already captured elsewhere at the same price). 'Brunch (Available 9:15/9:45am-2:00pm)' rendered completely empty both on a Monday at 12:00pm and on a Saturday at 12:00pm -- both squarely inside its stated availability window -- so this is a genuinely empty/unpopulated category, not a daypart-gating artifact, and was recorded as such rather than guessed at. Several items are priced by size/quantity (e.g. whole cakes $45-$70, macaron boxes $18.50-$113.00, some lattes/teas by cup size); for each, the LOWEST listed price is recorded and the range is disclosed in the dish description -- never averaged or invented. Some items (Parfait Signature, Le Noisette, Mango Bliss, Savory Breakfast Platter) legitimately appear in two sections at two different prices (whole cake vs. individual slice, or cross-listed platter) -- both kept as the source shows them.
